import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 10))

# Create a 2x2 grid of scatter plots showing relationships between features

ax1.set_title('Sepal Length vs Sepal Width', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)

ax3.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

ax3.set_title('Sepal Length vs Petal Length', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax3.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=11, fontsize=10)
